description: Recursively exact schema for the frozen adjudication family. Seven product objects are exact constants; the manifest is recursively closed and independently hash-validated.

decisions.admission_rationale: The first-party manual index identifies the public section set and visible section revision dates. It is admitted only for bounded manual-release and section-version custody.
The first-party policy section states the work-registration authority, superseded version, verification surface, and effective date.
The first-party policy section states the current public geographic-waiver position, superseded version, and effective date.
The first-party URL returned a script-only shell with no title or visible policy text. Transport identity is preserved, but the object is not admitted as field evidence.
The first-party policy section states a historical no-waiver period, section effective date, release identifier, and exact result-visible release and history-log links.

links.text: Able-Bodied Adults Without Dependents Able-bodied adults between the ages of 18-54 (subject to change) without dependents (ABAWDs) are eligible for participation in SNAP for only three (3) months within a 36-month period of time without working or participating in a work or welfare program for at least 20 hours weekly, averaged monthly, unless exempt. After exhausting the initial three (3) allowable months, ABAWD individuals meeting certain criteria may qualify for three (3) additional months of participation in the 36-month period.
eligible Having met the qualifications to receive a SNAP benefit by meeting the specified nonfinancial and financial requirements of eligibility.

reservation The geographically defined area over which an Indian Tribal Organization (ITO) exercises governmental jurisdiction as long as the area is legally recognized by the Federal or State government as being set aside for the use of Indians.

bounded_finding.finding_summary: Montana's captured public SNAP authority consists of the SNAP 0-1 manual index issued or revised July 1, 2026 together with SNAP 700 Work Registration effective June 1, 2025.

limitations: the index and work-registration section establish bounded public policy authority, not completeness of every Montana SNAP rule or its application in every case

bounded_finding.finding_summary: Montana's captured work-registration section is effective June 1, 2025, and its captured geographic-waiver section is effective November 1, 2025.

limitations: the finding contains section-specific effective dates and does not assert one comprehensive date for all Montana SNAP implementation

bounded_finding.finding_summary: Montana SNAP 802-1 states that, as of November 1, 2025, no areas within Montana have approved ABAWD geographic waivers.

bounded_finding.finding_summary: North Dakota policy section 403 Geographic Waiver states an effective date of November 1, 2025 and identifies Release 25.7.

bounded_finding.finding_summary: Section 403 states no waived reservations and no waived counties for July 1, 2025 through October 31, 2025, but the page is effective November 1, 2025 and does not expressly state the waiver geography or governing period after that date.

limitations: the historical no-waiver statement cannot be carried forward beyond October 31, 2025 without an explicit current surface
